# Governance

## Overview

This project is maintained by a single maintainer, [Arya Emami](https://github.com/aryaemami59). This document describes how decisions are made, so contributors know what to expect.

---

## Decision making

- The maintainer has final say on the project's scope, design, and what gets merged.
- Decisions are made in the open where practical - in issues and pull requests, rather than privately.
- Disagreement is welcome and is expected to stay within the [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Being right is not a reason to be unkind.

---

## Contributions

- Anyone may open an issue or pull request. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md).
- All changes, including the maintainer's, go through a pull request when practical.
- The maintainer reviews contributions as time allows. This is not a full-time project, so response times vary and a delay is not a judgment on your work.
- Not every contribution will be accepted. A change may be declined because it widens the project's scope or adds maintenance cost that outweighs its benefit - that is not a criticism of the contributor.

---

## Maintainership

There is no formal process for becoming a maintainer. If you contribute meaningfully over time and are interested in a larger role, open an issue or reach out - additional maintainers are added by invitation from the current maintainer.

---

## Changes to this document

This document may be updated by the maintainer. Substantive changes will be made via pull request so they can be discussed.
